annotations.description: THE BOUNDARIES OF THE PARTS OF LOTS WHICH ARE COURTYARDS SHOWN ON THE STRATA PLAN ARE TO THE OUTER SURFACE OF THE BUILDING WALL, THE INNER SURFACE OF ALL OTHER WALLS OR PIERS OR WHERE SHOWN DESIGNATED DIMENSIONS, THE UPPER SURFACE OF THEIR FLOOR AND THE PROLONGATION OF THE UNDER SURFACE OF THE CEILING OF THE RESPECTIVE BUILDING PART LOT EXCEPT WHERE COVERED. UNDER SCHEDULE 2A, CLAUSE 3AB OF THE STRATA TITLES ACT 1985, THE BOUNDARIES OF THE LOTS OR PART LOTS WHICH ARE BUILDINGS SHOWN ON THE STRATA PLAN ARE THE EXTERNAL SURFACES OF THOSE BUILDINGS. WHERE 2 LOTS HAVE A COMMON OR PARTY WALL OR HAVE BUILDINGS ON THEM WHICH ARE JOINED, THE CENTRE PLANE OF THAT WALL, OR THE PLANE AT WHICH THEY ARE JOINED, IS THE BOUNDARY. DISTANCES ARE FROM BOUNDARIES OR EXTERNAL FACES OF WALLS UNLESS SHOWN OTHERWISE. ALL ANGLES ARE 90 DEGREES UNLESS SHOWN OTHERWISE
